pages.text: Bone meal still works, but it is $(bold)not instant$().$(br2)When you fertilize a crop, the use is $(info)queued$() and applied at the next daily 6:00 settlement, all at once.$(br2)Each crop accepts at most $(thing)boneMealPerDay$() uses per MC day (default 1).

pages.title: Over-fertilizing
pages.text: Using bone meal beyond the daily limit makes the crop $(warn)wither instantly$(), and the bone meal is consumed.$(br2)If boneMealPerDay is set to 0, crops do not accept bone meal at all - using it does nothing to them.

pages.title: Fertilizing tips
pages.text: Each accepted use adds $(thing)boneMealProgress$() (default 10%) and at least one full growth stage, so the effect is always visible.$(br2)Bone meal works even on freshly planted crops, ignoring the minimum planting time.
